d: Jet black, voluminous curly hair is styled with a side-swept fringe, partially tucked under a white ruffled bonnet. Deep purple, wide eyes with a gentle expression are set on a youthful face with an adolescent maturity, paired with a slender build. The attire consists of a white Victorian-style bodice with pinstripes and a laced corset, layered over a long black skirt with white ruffled overskirts and white stockings with black pumps. Signature accessories include a white necktie, a single dark green glove on the left hand, and a vintage-style bronze microphone stand.
